verdict.rationale: Bento documents maintained first-party integrations that touch parts of an ops stack: WooCommerce for ecommerce, a ClickFunnels integration, and a Supabase SDK as a possible link to a product database. The story's named systems are not covered, since the evidence never mentions Stripe, Shopify or Segment. Missing for 10: a Stripe or Shopify integration, a Segment or other CDP connector, a documented product-database sync, and independent corroboration that the integrations are maintained.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect the platform to my existing stack — Stripe or Shopify, a CDP like Segment, my product database — with maintained first-party integrations

citations.quote: We maintain first-party packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js.
Bento has SDKs for JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, Python, Go, .NET, Rust, Swift, Meteor.js, and Supabase.
The Bento ClickFunnels integration adds the Bento tracking script to your funnels so page views are tracked and visitors are identified as subscribers in Bento.
